mustNotLearn.why: Health is never inferred as a fact about the person. The dictation stays searchable.
Financial position is never stored as a fact about the person.
A private detail about someone else is not promoted to a fact.
A message saying "I am exhausted" is a message, not a state Kivi records about the person.

preferences.statement: Keep Slack messages to two lines
Don't open emails with "Hope you're well"
